items.why: Inventory Brotli-using software and check for fixes, especially in the listed packages and proxies.

run_today: Inspect Downloads folders for untrusted AGENTS.md files before AI coding agents use them.
Review agent instructions before allowing them to trigger code or package installation.
Verify npm packages installed by coding agents against approved sources and requirements.

learn.explainer: A markdown file can provide instructions to an AI coding agent. In this report, researchers said a malicious file in a Downloads folder tricked an agent into installing a rogue npm package.
An air strike is an attack carried out from the air. The report describes an Israeli air strike on the Islamic University in Gaza City.
Economic sanctions are restrictions intended to put economic pressure on a country or other target. The report says Netanyahu is considering cryptocurrency as an answer to sanctions on Israel.

analysis.headline: Movement, conflict and trust in systems
paragraphs: The stories span movement restrictions, attacks and wider political effects. The top report says Israel’s military announced restrictions on Palestinian workers ahead of an election; other reports describe attacks in Gaza and opposition in Europe linked to energy costs and protests. Together, they show how conflict can affect daily life and political debate.

A different kind of exposure appears in the AI coding-agent report: researchers say a malicious file in Downloads led an agent to install a rogue npm package. This suggests that trusted-looking local instructions can influence automated tools, making file provenance and package review relevant to defenders.

The top items also include a report that SpaceX restricted Ukraine’s Starlink connection, with an accusation about military use. Analysts may watch how access restrictions, movement controls and digital-tool safeguards are described, while keeping reported claims distinct from confirmed detail.
takeaways: Treat local instructions and agent-triggered package installs as potential security risks.
Track how conflict reporting describes movement restrictions and their stated scope.
Separate reported accusations and proposals from established facts.
